title: Budget Freeze - Price Objection Despite Interest
agent_context: Prospect is interested but blocked by a budget freeze. Validate constraints, clarify timeline and approval path, and keep momentum with low-commitment next steps and a scheduled follow-up—without pressure or early discounting.

raw_content.initial_message: This looks good, but we’re in a budget freeze until next quarter. I can’t get anything approved right now.
raw_content.context: Prospect sees value but cannot purchase until budget reopens. Policy: don’t pressure or discount aggressively; clarify freeze end date, exceptions, approver, and procurement steps; propose low-commitment actions; schedule follow-up.

learning_objectives: Handle budget freeze objections without losing the deal
Clarify timeline, stakeholders, and approval requirements
Create a plan to be ready when budget opens
correct_sop_steps: Confirm priority and cost of delay
Schedule follow-up tied to budget window

sticky_notes: KEY: Budget freeze is timing — solve with a plan.

customer_persona_hints.secret_acceptance_condition: Will engage if timeline + plan + follow-up scheduled
